title: Find all female patients who were admitted to the hospital and have at leas
question: Find all female patients who were admitted to the hospital and have at least one abnormal liver enzyme (either GOT ≥ 60 or GPT ≥ 60). Among them, include only those who also have a recorded diagnosis in the Examination table and whose laboratory test occurred after their first hospital visit. Return their ID, sex, diagnosis, admission status, GOT, GPT, laboratory test date, and the number of days between their first hospital visit and the lab test. Order the results by the number of days elapsed in descending order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  P."XCL_058" AS ID,
  P."XCL_059" AS sex,
  E."XCL_008" AS diagnosis,
  E."XCL_013" AS admission_status,
  L."XCL_021" AS GOT,
  L."XCL_020" AS GPT,
  L."XCL_015" AS lab_test_date,
  CAST(julianday(L."XCL_015") - julianday(P."XCL_062") AS INTEGER) AS days_elapsed
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND E."XCL_013" > 0
  AND E."XCL_008" IS NOT NULL
  AND (L."XCL_021" >= 60 OR L."XCL_020" >= 60)
  AND L."XCL_015" > P."XCL_062"
ORDER BY days_elapsed DESC
